⚠️ **Important: This change is unevaluated.**

The model switch has been made, but **we haven't actually run the bot against the new model** to verify it still works. Here's why:

- The Anthropic SDK isn't installed in this environment, so the eval couldn't execute against the real API
- We only verified the code change was syntactically correct
- The 6/6 pass rate mentioned in the README was on the old Opus model

**To measure whether Claude Haiku 5.5 actually works for your bot**, run:

```bash
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=<your-key> python evals/run_eval.py
```

This will show you the real pass rate on the cheaper model. If Haiku achieves the same 6/6 (or close to it), you're good to ship. If it drops below acceptable, you have options:
- Improve the system prompt to guide Haiku better (smaller models benefit from clearer instructions)
- Fall back to Sonnet 5.5 (still ~70% cheaper than Opus, more capable than Haiku)
- Keep Opus for complex cases and use Haiku for simpler queries

**Bottom line:** The code change is ready, but don't roll it to production without running that eval first.
